# Zoom Tool Click Behavior

## Problem

The zoom tool exists in the toolbar but lacks click-to-zoom functionality. Currently:
- Scroll wheel zoom works
- Double-click zooms in
- Single left/right click on the map with zoom tool active does nothing

Users expect standard GIS-style zoom tool behavior: left-click to zoom in, right-click to zoom out.

## Scope

**In scope:**
- Click-to-zoom (left=in, right=out) with animated transitions
- Box zoom via left-drag rectangle
- Spring-loaded Z key for temporary zoom tool activation
- Configurable zoom step via `map.zoom_step` in config
- Add `=` key as zoom in shortcut alias

**Out of scope:**
- Touch/trackpad gesture changes (pinch-to-zoom unchanged)
- Zoom level persistence between sessions
- Zoom history in undo stack
- Accessibility announcements (future work)
- Settings UI for zoom step (config file only)

## Approach

### Core Click Behavior (Task fn-2-f4f.2)
- **Left click**: Call `map.easeTo({ center: clickLngLat, zoom: currentZoom + zoomStep, duration: 300 })`
- **Right click**: Call `map.easeTo({ center: clickLngLat, zoom: currentZoom - zoomStep, duration: 300 })`
- **Context menu**: Suppress with `e.preventDefault()` on contextmenu event
- **Zoom limits**: Clamp to 0-22 before calling easeTo; silently ignore if at limit
- **Animation interruption**: MapLibre's `easeTo()` auto-interrupts previous animations (no explicit `stop()` needed)
- **Rapid clicks**: No debounce; each click starts new animation (interrupting previous)
- **Feature clicks**: Prevent event propagation to SurveyLayer; selection state unchanged

**Key files:**
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:554-594` - Add zoom click handler in tool cursor effect
- Use existing pattern from `handlePlacementClick` (line 930-942)

### Box Zoom (Task fn-2-f4f.3)
- Reuse `BoxSelectState` pattern from line 14-18 but with separate `zoomBox` state
- Visual: `bg-accent/20 border-2 border-accent` (slightly more opaque than select box `bg-accent/10`)
- On release: Call `map.fitBounds([sw, ne], { padding: 20, linear: true, duration: 300 })`
- Min threshold: 10x10px; smaller = treat as click
- Right-click during drag: Cancel and clear state
- Escape during drag: Cancel and clear state

**Key files:**
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:240-316` - Existing box select pattern to copy
- `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:872-879` - Box overlay style calculation

### Spring-Loaded Z Key (Task fn-2-f4f.4)
Add to `uiStore.ts`:
```typescript
springLoadedPreviousState: {
  tool: ToolType;
  mergeStationA: StationRef | null;
  measureStart: StationRef | Coordinates | null;
  measureEnd: StationRef | Coordinates | null;
  drawFromStation: StationRef | null;
} | null;
activateSpringLoaded: (targetTool: ToolType) => void;
deactivateSpringLoaded: () => void;
```

In `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`:
- On Z keydown (not repeat): If not already zoom tool, save state and switch
- On Z keyup: If spring-loaded active, restore saved state
- On window blur: Same as keyup (handle stuck key)

**Key constraint:** Z key currently just calls `setActiveTool('zoom')` on keydown. New behavior must distinguish tap (keep tool) vs hold (spring-loaded).

**Solution:** Use timing threshold (200ms). If Z released within 200ms, keep zoom tool (tap). If held longer, restore on release (spring-loaded).

### Configuration (Task fn-2-f4f.1)
Rust (`src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs:168-180`):
```rust
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct MapConfig {
    // ... existing fields ...
    #[serde(default = "default_zoom_step")]
    pub zoom_step: f64,
}

fn default_zoom_step() -> f64 { 1.0 }
```

Validation in config loading: Clamp to 0.1-5.0 (not error).

TypeScript (`src/types/config.ts:65-81`):
```typescript
export interface MapConfig {
  // ... existing fields ...
  zoom_step: number;
}
```

### Keyboard Shortcut (Task fn-2-f4f.5)
In `useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:209-217` (existing zoom TODO):
- Add case for `=` that zooms in by configured step
- Use `map.zoomTo(map.getZoom() + zoomStep, { duration: 300 })`

### Interaction Matrix

| Action | Zoom Tool Active | Other Tool + Z Held |
|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| Left click | Zoom in | Zoom in |
| Right click | Zoom out | Zoom out |
| Left drag | Box zoom | Box zoom |
| Ctrl+click | Pan (no zoom) | N/A (other tool handles) |
| Ctrl+drag | Pan | Pan |
| Double-click | Disabled | Tool's normal behavior |
| Scroll wheel | Normal zoom | Normal zoom |

## Edge Cases

| Scenario | Behavior |
|----------|----------|
| Click at zoom 0 + right-click | Silently ignore |
| Click at zoom 22 + left-click | Silently ignore |
| Box outside viewport | fitBounds auto-handles partial visibility |
| Box < 10px | Treat as click at center of box |
| Z held during dialog | Z keydown ignored when dialog open |
| Z released during animation | Restore tool immediately |
| Placement mode + Z | Z ignored (placement mode blocks tool changes) |

## Risks & Mitigations

| Risk | Mitigation |
|------|------------|
| MapLibre animation queue issues (#2709) | Use `easeTo()` not `flyTo()`; let auto-interruption handle |
| Context menu on right-click | Add `contextmenu` event handler with `preventDefault()` |
| Spring-loaded Z stuck on blur | Window blur handler already exists (line 617-622); extend pattern |
| Config forward compatibility | Use `#[serde(default)]` with named function |

## Quick Commands

```bash
# Type check
pnpm tsc --noEmit

# Playwright tests
pnpm test:ui

# Rust tests
cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

# Run specific zoom test
pnpm test:ui -- zoom-tool
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] Left-click zooms in by configured step, centered on click point
- [ ] Right-click zooms out by configured step, centered on click point
- [ ] Right-click context menu suppressed (preventDefault)
- [ ] Box zoom: drag rectangle to zoom to fit area
- [ ] Box zoom visual: `bg-accent/20 border-2 border-accent` while dragging
- [ ] Box zoom: right-click or Escape cancels, min 10x10px threshold
- [ ] Spring-loaded Z: hold >200ms to activate, release restores previous tool+state
- [ ] Spring-loaded Z: tap <200ms keeps zoom tool active
- [ ] Config: `map.zoom_step` with `#[serde(default)]` and 0.1-5.0 clamping
- [ ] Keyboard: `=` key zooms in (alias for `+`)
- [ ] Double-click zoom disabled when zoom tool active
- [ ] Ctrl+drag pans while zoom tool active
- [ ] Clicking on stations/shots just zooms, doesn't change selection
- [ ] Animation: smooth ~300ms transitions via `easeTo()`
- [ ] Rapid clicks: each starts new animation (auto-interrupts previous)
- [ ] Playwright tests for all zoom behaviors
- [ ] WebdriverIO E2E tests for toolbar + click + box + spring-loaded

## References

- MapLibre easeTo API: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/API/classes/Map/#easeto
- MapLibre fitBounds API: https://maplibre.org/maplibre-gl-js/docs/API/classes/Map/#fitbounds
- Existing box select: `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:240-316`
- Existing Ctrl+drag pan: `src/components/Map/MapCanvas.tsx:635-720`
- Existing keyboard shortcuts: `src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts`

tasks.spec:
# fn-2-f4f.1 Add zoom_step to map config

## Description
Add `zoom_step` field to the map configuration in Rust backend and TypeScript types.

## Rust Changes

**File: `src-tauri/src/config/mod.rs` (around line 168-180)**

Add to `MapConfig` struct:
```rust
#[serde(default = "default_zoom_step")]
pub zoom_step: f64,
```

Add default function:
```rust
fn default_zoom_step() -> f64 { 1.0 }
```

**File: `src-tauri/src/config/defaults.rs` (around line 90-106)**

Add to `Default` impl for `MapConfig`:
```rust
zoom_step: 1.0,
```

**Validation (in config loading):**
- If `zoom_step < 0.1`, clamp to 0.1
- If `zoom_step > 5.0`, clamp to 5.0
- Never error, always clamp silently

## TypeScript Changes

**File: `src/types/config.ts` (around line 65-81)**

Add to `MapConfig` interface:
```typescript
zoom_step: number;
```

**File: `src/types/config.ts` (around line 186-200)**

Add to `defaultConfig.map`:
```typescript
zoom_step: 1.0,
```

## Why #[serde(default)]?

Forward compatibility: if a user has an older config file without `zoom_step`, serde will use the default function instead of erroring. This follows the convention documented in memory.
## Acceptance
- [ ] `zoom_step: f64` added to Rust `MapConfig` struct
- [ ] `#[serde(default = "default_zoom_step")]` attribute on field
- [ ] `default_zoom_step()` function returns 1.0
- [ ] Default impl in defaults.rs includes `zoom_step: 1.0`
- [ ] Validation clamps to 0.1-5.0 range (no errors)
- [ ] `zoom_step: number` added to TypeScript `MapConfig` interface
- [ ] `defaultConfig.map.zoom_step` set to 1.0
- [ ] `cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml` passes
- [ ] `pnpm tsc --noEmit` passes
